agentage-memory.description: Agentage Memory - one memory shared across every AI, owned by you. Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) for a markdown memory that Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT read and write through 6 tools (memory__search, memory__read, memory__write, memory__edit, memory__list, memory__delete). OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + Dynamic Client Registration; no manual token. https://memory.agentage.io
